name: Can standard residential bathroom fixtures be installed in a mobile home?

mainEntity.name: Can standard residential bathroom fixtures be installed in a mobile home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can install standard residential bathtubs, vanities, and showers, but they frequently require reframing and plumbing line modifications. Factory-installed manufactured home tubs are typically smaller than standard 60-inch residential models, often measuring 54 inches. Upgrading to residential fixtures involves altering surrounding wall studs, adjusting drain trap alignments, and reinforcing the subfloor to carry filled tub weight. A qualified general contractor can adapt the framing and coordinate plumbing rough-ins so modern tile surrounds and residential bathtubs fit seamlessly within the available footprint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but standard fixtures usually require custom reframing, subfloor reinforcement, and plumbing adjustments because mobile home dimensions are often more compact.
